howTo.title: How it works
howTo.item1: The settings apply per sales channel — the selector sits at the top of this page.
howTo.item2: Kontotyp „Firma“ erzwingen hides the choice in the registration form and creates every new account as a company account.
howTo.item3: Gast/Konto-Auswahl controls whether customers can choose between a guest order and a customer account during checkout.
howTo.item4: Both rules apply to registration in the account area and in the checkout alike, and are enforced server-side — a manipulated form does not get around them.
howTo.item5: With guest ordering enforced, the password fields stay visible on the standalone registration page; a guest account is created regardless.

info.description: Trims the registration form to B2B: forces the company account type and removes the guest/account choice (configurable: always account or always guest). Toggleable per sales channel.
